Healthy and Zesty Cabbage Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, December 14, 2009 - 12:33am

Ingredients




3 cups finely shredded green cabbage
1/2 cup chopped dry-roasted peanuts
1 chopped green chili (optional)
1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds
1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds
2 tablespoons olive oil
Salt to taste
3 tablespoons fresh lime juice
1/4 cup chopped cilantro

Preparation

1 In a salad bowl, mix cabbage, peanuts and green chili. Set aside. When ready to serve, heat olive oil in a small frying pan over medium heat. When hot, put in mustard seeds. As soon as mustard seeds begin to pop, add cumin seeds and let crackle for 3-4 seconds. Turn heat off and immediately add oil-mustard-cumin seasoning to salad mix. Add salt and lime juice. Mix well.
